query:
UPDATE memory.lessons l
                    SET stage_id        = daily_s.id,
                        embedding       = $2::text::vector,
                        embedding_model = $3,
                        embedded_at     = NOW()
                   FROM memory.lesson_stages daily_s,
                        memory.lesson_stages raw_s
                  WHERE daily_s.code = 'daily'
                    AND raw_s.code = 'raw'
                    AND l.id = $1
                    AND l.stage_id = raw_s.id
